case.title: Breathing in, breathing out
case.hook: A giant star swelling and shrinking every 14 months, brightening a thousandfold. Strange to the eye, ordinary to astrophysics.

query.adql: SELECT source_id, ra, dec, parallax, parallax_over_error, pmra, pmdec, ruwe, phot_g_mean_mag, phot_bp_mean_mag, phot_rp_mean_mag, bp_rp, phot_variable_flag, teff_gspphot, distance_gspphot, non_single_star, DISTANCE(POINT(294.20565827354,50.19992431583001), POINT(ra,dec))*3600 AS sep_arcsec FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT(ra,dec), CIRCLE(294.20565827354,50.19992431583001,0.008333333333333333)) ORDER BY sep_arcsec

notes: rows_kept counts 6-month visits (W1 and W2), not exposures
observers (good points): MVD:740, SGEA:496, TRE:436, MEV:385, JENJ:132, LCLA:118, AAM:107, KNAA:69, SRIC:64, AMIF:53, MJOE:50, DFEA:50
upper limits, discrepant (val=T) and non-standard bands are kept but flagged; visual estimates form their own series 'Vis.'
no ZTF source (target may be brighter than ZTF saturation, ~12.5 mag)
Sky Patrol light-curve service failed: ZeroDivisionError: integer modulo by zero

checks.title: Does AAVSO start at the star's normal brightness?
checks.finding: first 60 days of V: median 7.25; Gaia DR3 (2014-17 mean) implies V = 13.88; difference -6.64 mag. The series begins mid-event: its own median is not the star's normal state.
